title: Upgrade dry-run harness for Private (VPC/on-prem) with compatibility probes and LTS gate integration
creator: Meera Patel
description: Build a deterministic dry-run harness that can perform non-destructive rehearsals of Private (VPC / on-prem) upgrades. The harness should exercise schema migrations, config transforms, deployment manifests and service orchestration without mutating customer data. It will integrate compatibility probes (schema/CRD compatibility, KV format checks, API contract smoke tests) and produce a single migration artifact that can be consumed by rollout gates on LTS channels. Goal: detect upgrade regressions and compatibility hazards before an actual upgrade window and provide actionable remediation hints.
acceptance_criteria: Dry-run harness can execute upgrade rehearsals end-to-end against a cloned staging environment without writing to production backstores
Compatibility probes include: DB schema diff + dry-apply report, manifest drift checker, API contract smoke tests, and KV cache validation
Rehearsal run produces a single JSON 'migration verdict' artifact with pass/fail, risk score, and remediation suggestions
Migration verdict artifact is consumable by release-rollout gates and can block LTS channel promotion if risk score > threshold
Automated nightly rehearsals can be scheduled per-customer or per-cluster and historical verdicts are stored in S3 for 90 days
Integration tests cover harness idempotency and non-destructive behavior against a synthetic dataset
Security review completed and artifact signing added for LP/enterprise customers
tasks: Design dry-run architecture: orchestration runner, probe adapters, verdict aggregator
Implement manifest/helm diff probe and produce human-readable output
Add DB schema dry-apply probe (pg/redis) that reports destructive migrations
Create API contract smoke test harness using existing e2e test suites with replayable fixtures
Build verdict aggregator service that normalizes probe outputs into a risk score and remediation checklist
Expose verdict artifact in releases service and wire into rollout gate evaluation rules
Add CLI to kick off rehearsal runs and to abort/inspect running rehearsals
Add end-to-end tests and a canary rehearsal job in CI
Document runbook for SRE and Solutions Engineers with troubleshooting steps
notes: This is intended to reduce live-migration incidents during LTS channel rollouts by catching issues earlier
We will avoid any production mutations by default; if an operator opts into a 'safer dry-apply' mode it will run in a fenced namespace with synthetic data
Risk scoring model should weight destructive schema operations, manifest API changes, and failing smoke tests higher
Plan to reuse existing migration telemetry collectors from runtime to enrich verdicts
Rollout gating will initially be opt-in for non-critical customers and required for enterprise accounts on LTS channels
